title: FEMA flood mitigation grants align with past losses but not new floodplain development: code and derived data
description: Code and derived data for a national analysis of whether FEMA Hazard Mitigation Assistance funding, applications and project sites are associated with new development in mapped floodplains of the contiguous United States (2000-2025). The archive contains the analysis scripts, derived county, county-year and ZIP-code tables, model outputs, the analysis plan and the source, download date and checksum of every public input file. Code is released under the MIT licence; derived data under CC BY 4.0.
